intent: Replaces 2026-10-04-ladder-reset, which was invalidated when all 16 N records were swept to ZN outside the changeset process (15 from_subcat mismatches). Places the newly imported records staged in subcat 51 (Y) - 40 from the first import plus 5 of 8 from the second, disables 9 superseded duplicate files, rebuilds N, and returns A1/A2/B/C to target depth. Authored purely on chart evidence from the 2026-09-28 baseline pull against the Config 11.2 rescaled floors (A1 top-8, A2 top-15, B top-25-or-Spincrease). PD input remains disregarded this week by PD/MD instruction.

basis.supersedes: changesets/2026-10-04-ladder-reset-v2.json (superseded by a second PD import of 8 records into Y)

notes: ENTRY RULE for this reset, applied to the 31 unique new imports: 7-Day chart presence = established airplay = enter at the evidence rung, bypassing N. Absent from 7-Day (Spincrease and/or Taking Off only) = still breaking = enter at N. This is a principled line rather than a judgement call, and it is what fills N: 13 of its 18 seats come from imports that are gaining but have not yet charted.

N now lands at 18 of 18 - AT TARGET. The second PD import (ids 1950-1957) supplied the five short. Of the eight, five are placed and three are held in Y as the Config 6 on-deck queue: Slipknot 'Arsenal' (2 AR adds), Blossoms 'Meet Me In Love' (Radio X daytime only, no US source) and Slightly Stoopid 'Backseat Drivin' (1 ALT add). They are the three weakest by evidence, not by preference, and Y is not a scheduling category so they will not air while they wait.

DUPLICATE HANDLING. Five imports are higher-quality replacements of songs already in the library (ids 1687, 1670, 463, 634, 2); the old file is DISABLED in place rather than moved, so it can never be selected while the replacement airs, and disabling removes it from enabled depth. Four more are untagged/Clean pairs within the import itself; the Clean version is placed and the untagged one disabled. THE CLEAN-OVER-UNTAGGED CHOICE IS A PD DECISION - the station has no stated policy and the import mixes Clean, Dirty, Radio Edit and Original Mix. Inverting it is a one-line change.

ARTIST SEPARATION drove three placements. FFDP 'Eye Of The Storm' (AR #16) goes to C rather than B because 'Nails In The Coffin' (AR #12) takes the FFDP seat in B; Evanescence 'Afterlife' and Sublime 'Ensenada' are benched for the same reason. FORMAT-WORKFLOW 1a.6: duplicate artists in a thin pool produce fill failures, not merely tighter rotation.

FOUR RECALLS FROM ZN. Nickelback (AR #2), Buffalo Traffic Jam (ALT #3), Edgehill (ALT #12) and Sam Fender (ALT #17) were swept N->ZN outside the changeset process, not retired by rule. They are restored to their evidence rungs rather than treated as ZN residents. Nothing But Thieves 'Evolution' (632) is left in ZN this week - it is Taking Off-only and N is already being filled from stronger imports.

DROPS STILL DEFERRED. 11.3's fell_off and trajectory triggers need a prior archive week; 2026-09-28 remains the only one. Every bench here rests on present-tense evidence - absent from all panel sources, or superseded by an imported record - which needs no history.

DATA QUALITY: Dominic Fike 'Babydoll' (id 557) is 97 seconds in A2, against a ~2:40 record. It is left in place on evidence (ALT #8) but the file looks truncated and it sits in a power tier at ~23 plays/week. Recommend checking before the next log generation.

NOT ADDRESSED: Young The Giant 'Evergreen' (id 1673, ALT #16) sits in W and was not imported because it is already owned. It is a recall candidate, not a sourcing need, and is left for the 2026-10-04 pass.

FORMAT BALANCE RESTORED. Before the second import N would have landed near 6 Active Rock / 15 Alternative, badly skewed against the 2.1 Active Rock x Alternative hybrid. The five placements here are 3 AR / 2 ALT, bringing N to roughly 7 AR / 11 ALT. Still alternative-leaning, but no longer lopsided against half the format.

OPEN - ENTRY RULE DEFECT, raised 2026-09-30, NOT applied here. The entry rule keys on 7-Day presence, but the add boards show commitment the 7-Day has not caught up to. Sublime 'F.T.R.' took 11 Alternative + 9 Active Rock adds (20 combined, the widest of any record on either board) plus ALT Spincrease #2 and ALT Taking Off! #1, and Beabadoobee 'Write Me A Letter' is the most-added Alternative record at 12 - yet both sit in N while Des Rocs at AR #25 bypasses it. Proposed fix: bypass N on 7-Day presence OR top-3 on either add board, which would move exactly these two to B. Left unapplied pending PD approval; applying it would take N to 16 and need two more records.
